R: CSDA range of protons in water, the path they travel while slowing to rest at the mean rate
R_20: Depth past the peak where the dose has fallen to 20 % of the peak
R_80: Depth past the peak where the dose has fallen to 80 % of the peak
S: Stopping power, the rate a proton loses energy per unit path, −dE/dx
beta: Speed of the proton as a fraction of the speed of light, v/c
d: Depth in water below the surface
d_max: Depth of the photon beam's dose maximum
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
mu_eff: Effective attenuation coefficient of the photon beam in water
r: Residual range, the range a proton still has left
sigma: Standard deviation of the depths where the protons stop
w: Width of the target the spread out peak covers
